29016-harper-s-young-people-june-29-1880.description: A public-domain book from Project Gutenberg. "Lie still, fellows," said Tom, as the other boys tried to wriggle out from under the tent. "We've got to get wet now, anyway; but perhaps, if we stay as we are, we can manage to keep the blankets dry."

44148-the-confessions-of-a-daddy.title: The Confessions Of A Daddy
44148-the-confessions-of-a-daddy.creator: Ellis Parker Butler
44148-the-confessions-of-a-daddy.description: A book by Ellis Parker Butler. 'T was n't that we hated children. We just thought that when we saw all the extra worry and trouble and expense that other people's children brought about, we were right satisfied to live the way we had lived the five years since we was married--our neighbors still called us the “Bride and Groom.

arxiv-1504-05660.title: Novel energy level structure of Dirac oscillator in magnetic field
arxiv-1504-05660.creator: Md. Moniruzzaman, S. B. Faruque
arxiv-1504-05660.description: Abstract We have presented an elegant high energy quantum problem, namely, the full Dirac oscillator under axial magnetic field with its full solution. We have found the energy spectrum which is rich and at the same time has a novel structure.

arxiv-2111-00291.title: A way of fast calculating lepton magnetic moments in quantum electrodynamics E-mail: sergey.volkov.1811@gmail.com, volkoff_sergey@mail.ru
arxiv-2111-00291.description: Abstract A new method of divergence subtraction in Feynman parametric integrals is presented. The method is suitable for calculating the lepton anomalous magnetic moments (AMM) in quantum electrodynamics (QED). The subtraction procedure eliminates all divergences before integration and leads to a finite Feynman parametric integral for each individual Feynman diagram.

arxiv-2112-08793.title: Fire retainment on Cayley graphs
arxiv-2112-08793.creator: Gideon Amir, Rangel Baldasso, Maria Gerasimova, Gady Kozma
arxiv-2112-08793.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by Gideon Amir, Rangel Baldasso, Maria Gerasimova, Gady Kozma. We study the fire-retaining problem on groups, a quasi-isometry invariant 1 1 footnotemark: 1 introduced by Martínez-Pedroza and Prytuła [ 8 ] , related to the firefighter problem.

arxiv-2206-13667.creator: Pengfei Zhang, Yi Xing, Zhongxiang Wang
arxiv-2206-13667.description: Abstract Motivated by the newly discovery of a spin period 1.83 ms pulsar J1835 − - 3259B in the globular cluster (GC) NGC 6652, we analyze the γ \gamma -ray data obtained with the Large Area Telescope (LAT) onboard Fermi Gamma-ray Space Telescope (Fermi) for the GC and detect the pulsations of this millisecond pulsar (MSP) at a 5.

arxiv-2207-07357.title: Generalization of edge general position problem
arxiv-2207-07357.creator: Paul Manuel, R. Prabha, Sandi Klavžar
arxiv-2207-07357.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Paul Manuel, R. Prabha, Sandi Klavžar. The edge geodesic cover problem of a graph G G is to find a smallest number of geodesics that cover the edge set of G G . The edge k k -general position problem is introduced as the problem to find a largest set S S of edges of G G such that no k − 1 k-1 edges of S S lie on a common geodesic.

arxiv-2307-01970.title: Understanding Resolution of Multi-Language Bugs: An Empirical Study on Apache Projects PubID: pubid: 978-1-6654-5223-6/23/$31.00 ©2023 IEEE
arxiv-2307-01970.creator: Zengyang Li 2 , Wenshuo Wang 2 , Sicheng Wang 2 , Peng Liang 3 1 , Ran Mo 2
arxiv-2307-01970.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Zengyang Li 2 , Wenshuo Wang 2 , Sicheng Wang 2 , Peng Liang 3 1 , Ran Mo 2. Background : In modern software systems, more and more systems are written in multiple programming languages (PLs). There is no comprehensive investigation on the phenomenon of multi-programming-language (MPL) bugs, which resolution involves source files written in multiple PLs. Aim : This work investigated the characteristics of bug resolution in MPL software systems and explored the reasons why bug resolution involves multiple PLs.

arxiv-2403-00570.title: Rethinking cluster-conditioned diffusion models for label-free image synthesis
arxiv-2403-00570.creator: Nikolas Adaloglou, Tim Kaiser, Felix Michels, Markus Kollmann
arxiv-2403-00570.description: Abstract Diffusion-based image generation models can enhance image quality when conditioned on ground truth labels. Here, we conduct a comprehensive experimental study on image-level conditioning for diffusion models using cluster assignments. We investigate how individual clustering determinants, such as the number of clusters and the clustering method, impact image synthesis across three different datasets.

arxiv-2406-01907.title: Extended Massive Ambitwistor String
arxiv-2406-01907.creator: Christian Kunz
arxiv-2406-01907.description: Abstract This work considers a variation of the massive ambitwistor string model presented in arXiv:2301.11227 that describes supergravity and super-Yang-Mills on the Coulomb branch simultaneously with a single Lagrangian. All-multiplicity tree and one-loop amplitudes are evaluated and shown to have proper unitary factorization. The massless limit provides Einstein Yang-Mills amplitudes including multiple gluon traces.

arxiv-2504-03036.title: IPA CHILDES & G2P+: Feature-Rich Resources for Cross-Lingual Phonology and Phonemic Language Modeling
arxiv-2504-03036.creator: Zébulon Goriely Paula Buttery
arxiv-2504-03036.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Zébulon Goriely Paula Buttery. In this paper, we introduce two resources: (i) G2P+ , a tool for converting orthographic datasets to a consistent phonemic representation; and (ii) IPA CHILDES , a phonemic dataset of child-centered speech across 31 languages. Prior tools for grapheme-to-phoneme conversion result in phonemic vocabularies that are inconsistent with established phonemic inventories, an issue which G2P+ addresses by leveraging the inventories in the Phoible database ( Moran and McCloy 2019 ) .

pmc-10478462.creator: Letong Cai, Yuchen Li, Jiaxiong Tan, Ling Xu, Yangqiu Li

pmc-11453886.creator: Katherine Granados, Alfonso Durán, Frankis Almaguel, Daisy De Leon
pmc-11453886.description: Disclosure: K. Granados: None. A. Durán: None. F. Almaguel: None. D. We demonstrated that IGF-II achieves this by inhibiting pro-apoptotic proteins and stimulating anti-apoptotic proteins.

pmc-11457103.creator: V. Pomjakushin
pmc-11457103.description: The magnetic and crystal structures of manganese and nickel monoxides have been analysed for possible multi-k solutions and compared with high-resolution neutron diffraction data. pmc-11490559.title: Nomograms for predicting short-term mortality in acute-on-chronic liver disease caused by the combination of hepatitis B virus and alcohol
pmc-11490559.creator: Hongqin Xu, Hai Li, Wenting Tan, Xianbo Wang, Xin Zheng, Yan Huang, Jinjun Chen, Zhongji Meng, Zhiping Qian, Feng Liu, Xiaobo Lu, Yu Shi, Yubao Zheng, Huadong Yan, Weituo Zhang, Xiaoyu Wen, Tao Liu, Yue Feng, Liang Qiao, Wenyi Gu, Yan Zhang, Guohong Deng, Yi Zhou, Shuning Sun, Yixin Hou, Qun Zhang,
pmc-11490559.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). This study aimed to identify predictive factors for the prognosis of acute-on-chronic liver disease (AoCLD) due to both hepatitis B virus (HBV) and alcohol and to develop prognostic models to improve treatment management. AoCLD patients with HBV and alcohol as etiological factors were selected from two multicenter prospective cohorts (NCT02457637,NCT03641872) and included in separate training and validation cohorts (n = 180 and n = 148).

pmc-11520663.title: The use of outcome data from quality registries to learn and improve; a Dutch nationwide quantitative analysis in five disease areas
pmc-11520663.creator: Stacey R. Slingerland, Lise A. M. Moers, Niki M. Medendorp, Paul B. van der Nat, Lineke Derks, Marijke J. C. Timmermans, Nicolette de Keizer, Marc ten Dam, Geke Denissen, Dennis van Veghel
pmc-11520663.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). BackgroundClinical quality registries (CQR) aid in measuring, collecting and monitoring outcome data but it is still unknown how these data are used by hospitals to improve the quality of care. This study assessed the current state of outcome-based quality improvement in the Netherlands in 2022 based on data from multiple disease areas and CQRs; cardiothoracic surgery (Netherlands Heart Registration [NHR]), cardiology (NHR), nephrology, (Nefrovision), intensive care (National Intensive Care Evaluation [NICE]), and orthopaedic surgery (Dutch Arthroplasty Register [LROI]).Methods & resultsThe Health Outcomes

pmc-11528757.title: Effects of a combination of dyslipidemia and hypertension on the glycemic control of patients with type 2 diabetes mellitus: a cross-sectional study
pmc-11528757.creator: Heqing Lou, Yixue Jiang, Chunrong Xu, Zong-Mei Dong, De Liu, Cheng Qiao, Pan Zhang
pmc-11528757.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). Objectives:Both dyslipidemia and hypertension contribute to poor glycemic control in patients with type 2 diabetes mellitus, but the combined effect of dyslipidemia and hypertension on glycemic control in patients with type 2 diabetes mellitus has not been evaluated.

pmc-11570240.title: Recent developments in Achilles tendon risk-analyzing rupture factors for enhanced injury prevention and clinical guidance: Current implications of regenerative medicine
pmc-11570240.creator: Maria V. Sankova, Narasimha M. Beeraka, Marine V. Oganesyan, Negoriya A. Rizaeva, Aleksey V. Sankov, Olga S. Shelestova, Kirill V. Bulygin, Hemanth Vikram PR, A.N. Barinov, A.K. Khalimova, Y. Padmanabha Reddy, Basappa Basappa, Vladimir N. Nikolenko
pmc-11570240.description: BackgroundIn recent years, many countries have actively implemented programs and strategies to promote physical education and sports. Despite these efforts, the increase in physical activity has been accompanied by a significant rise in muscle and tendon-ligament injuries, with Achilles tendon rupture being the most prevalent, accounting for 47 % of such injuries.

pmc-12583748.title: A Language model-based approach to sentiment classification of languages in central Asia
pmc-12583748.creator: Palidan Muhetaer, Guo Wenqiang, Lu Chong
pmc-12583748.description: Xinjiang is located in the hinterland of the Asia-Europe continent, neighboring Kazakhstan and Kyrgyzstan, and is a bridgehead for China’s eastward connection to the west, and the classification of Central Asian language emotions has become a development focus under the Belt and Road Initiative in Xinjiang.

pmc-12629536.title: Social relationships and epigenetic markers of aging in middle-aged and older adults: cross-sectional and prospective analyses
pmc-12629536.creator: Danmeng Lily Li, Xiaojing Xu, Allison M Hodge, Melissa C Southey, Graham G Giles, Roger L Milne, Pierre-Antoine Dugué
pmc-12629536.description: ObjectivesSocial relationships play an important role in maintaining physical and psychological health. Epigenetic age is a potential mechanism underlying health-related aspects of social relationships. We aimed to assess the cross-sectional and prospective associations of social relationships and epigenetic age in middle-aged and older adults.

pmc-12649431.title: Deep Q-Learning for Gastrointestinal Disease Detection and Classification
pmc-12649431.creator: Aini Saba, Javaria Amin, Muhammad Umair Ali, Fabiano Bini
pmc-12649431.description: Stomach ulcers, a common type of gastrointestinal (GI) disease, pose serious health risks if not diagnosed and treated at an early stage. Therefore, in this research, a method is proposed based on two deep learning models for classification and segmentation.

pmc-12672525.title: Surgical considerations in hyperopic cataract patients: optimizing outcomes and reducing complications
pmc-12672525.creator: Reem AlHuthail
pmc-12672525.description: Cataract surgery in hyperopic individuals presents unique anatomical and physiological challenges, including shallow anterior chambers, increased lens vaults, and a higher risk of intraoperative complications. This review explores key considerations for preoperative assessment, surgical planning, and intraoperative techniques tailored to hyperopic eyes.

pmc-12702068.title: The effectiveness of cervical medial branch radiofrequency ablation using a three-tined electrode: A real-world cross-sectional cohort study
pmc-12702068.creator: Hasan Sen, Napatpaphan Kanjanapanang, Amanda N. Cooper, Seth Bires, Audrey Adler, Akbar Nabi, Blake Dickenson, William Tang, Chase Young, Taylor Burnham, Allison Glinka Przybysz, Aaron Conger, Zachary L. McCormick
pmc-12702068.description: BackgroundCervical medial branch radiofrequency ablation (CMBRFA) using conventional electrodes is a proven treatment for chronic cervical zygapophysial (facet) joint pain. More recently, multi-tined RFA technology has been adopted in clinical practice, warranting evaluation of treatment outcomes.ObjectivesEvaluate the effectiveness of CMBRFA using a three-tined RFA electrode for the treatment of cervical facet joint pain in a real-world cohort.

pmc-12831434.title: Network dynamics of metabolic disease continuum in older adults: a 7-year longitudinal cohort study in China
pmc-12831434.creator: Guoqing Xu, Qingxian Song, Meng Jia, Yingni Yu, Shu Su, Jinning Mao
pmc-12831434.description: BackgroundMetabolic diseases co-occur as multimorbidity rather than presenting in isolation. This study aims to estimate the evolution and patterns of multimorbidity networks centered on metabolic disease continuum (MDC) among old adults to understand the accumulation over time and identify factors associated with multimorbidity.

pmc-13085744.title: Addressing organizational risk factors and interventions during transitions of care for older patients: a systematic umbrella review
pmc-13085744.creator: Britt Wagenaar, Bo Schouten, Johannes CF Ket, Cordula Wagner, Hanneke Merten
pmc-13085744.description: BackgroundThe global aging population presents significant challenges for healthcare systems, with projections indicating that by 2050, individuals aged 65 and above will total 1.6 billion. Older adults, often experience chronic conditions and face frequent transitions in care, which can result in fragmented care and increased risks.

pmc-13389965.title: Play deficits in preschool and first-grade school adaptation: a longitudinal study
pmc-13389965.creator: Margarita Gavrilova, Ali Kemal Tekin
pmc-13389965.description: The transition from preschool to primary school is a critical period characterized by adaptation difficulties for a significant number of children. Although play is considered a key context for the development of self-regulation, intrinsic motivation and other abilities necessary for successful school adaptation, its specific role in this process remains understudied.

pmc-13600864.title: Gut microbiota and short-chain fatty acids in pregnant women with group B Streptococcus colonization and their impact on neonatal outcomes
pmc-13600864.creator: Yao Zhu, Yan Ni, Yayin Lin, Xinsi Chen, Jidong Lai, Xinzhu Lin, Chao Chen
pmc-13600864.description: BackgroundGroup B Streptococcus (GBS) frequently colonizes the gastrointestinal and lower reproductive tracts in pregnant women. However, research has predominantly addressed its influence on the vaginal microbiota, leaving its effects on the gut ecosystem and the consequent implications for neonatal outcomes largely unexplored.

uslaw-usc-t22-s7423.title: 22 U.S.C. § 7423 — Prohibition on cooperation with the International Criminal Court
uslaw-usc-t22-s7423.creator: United States Congress
uslaw-usc-t22-s7423.description: United States Code, Title 22 (Foreign Relations And Intercourse); Chapter 81 (International Criminal Court); Subchapter II (American Servicemembers’ Protection). Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. (a) Application The provisions of this section— (1) apply only to cooperation with the International Criminal Court and shall not apply to cooperation with an ad hoc international criminal tribunal established by the United Nations Security Council before.
